install.userOwnedExclusion: Uninstall only removes an installer-owned symlink at ~/.grok/skills/pipeline. Never deletes the Claude-managed skill tree target or unrelated files under ~/.grok.
install.postInstall: Skill path is a symlink to the Claude-managed install (no separate Grok SKILL.md). After a Claude skill update, re-run: node scripts/install.mjs install --host grok

early_run_handoff.how: Same durable handoff JSON as Claude overlay path; parse run_id and events path from stdout.

reattach.how: Re-arm host monitor / event follow after cancelled wait; cancelled wait is not terminal.

wait_cancel.how: Cancelled wait is non-terminal; re-follow until terminal loop/run events.

material_progress_notify.how: Host monitor on material-filtered stream (each stdout line = chat bubble). Never require Claude PushNotification.
material_progress_notify.fallback: stdout material lines via events.jsonl + material-filter.mjs

terminal_cleanup.how: Stop monitors/follows for this run_id on terminal.
